verdict.rationale: Lium's docs describe an official MCP server at `/mcp` that an agent can connect to. It exposes named tools for searching and reading the docs (`search`, `read_page`) and for live GPU prices and availability (`search_gpus`, `get_gpu_prices`). The documented tool surface is read-only, and renting appears only as 'rent links', so pod lifecycle actions are not shown over MCP. Missing for 10: MCP tools for renting or managing pods, connection and auth setup documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration that the endpoint works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use the MCP server at `/mcp` to search and read the docs (`search`, `read_page`) and to see live GPU prices and availability with rent links (`search_gpus`, `get_gpu_prices`).
